summary: Stop condition 3 fired before any file was moved. source_evidence.rs, which Section 3 moves verbatim into truck-certified/src/, contains a `use crate::tessellation::domain::lattice::CertifiedLattice;` inside its own `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (line 842). This is a 13th `use crate::tessellation` site in the moved tree. Per the packet's rule ('Every moved file moves verbatim except the mechanical import rewrites enumerated in Section 4'; 'If you find yourself editing anything else inside a moved module, STOP'), the worker must stop and report rather than add a table row on its own judgement.

secondary_finding.premise: The packet authorizes exactly one non-verbatim line inside source_evidence.rs: 'its `use super::*;` (line 1) must become the explicit import set rustc demands (`super` is now the certified crate root, whose pub items are the four modules ...)'.
secondary_finding.actual_tree: source_evidence.rs has NO top-level `use super::*;`. The file's only `use super::*;` is at line 581, inside `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`, where `super` is the `source_evidence` module itself (unchanged after the move), so it compiles as-is and no rewrite is demanded by rustc. The packet's single authorized edit therefore has no real subject in the current tree; the only compile-fixing edit the file actually needs (line 842 above) is not authorized. Anchor A8 (`grep -c 'use super::*;' source_evidence.rs` == 1) is satisfied, confirming the packet's line-1 attribution is stale against the vendored tree (the file is unmodified since the vendoring commit da72cd5).
